## Success criteria

- [ ] Concept is independent of any vendor.
- [ ] Evidence cites primary sources and dates/pinned SHAs.
- [ ] Verified, Inferred, Hypothesis, Unknown are distinct.
- [ ] Failure modes, consistency, security and cost considered.
- [ ] Experiment or falsifiable next step documented.
- [ ] Findings integrated into relevant domain brief and linked observations.
